This undermines the principle of * free will* in giving, which is central to Christian ethics. While supporting charitable causes is biblically aligned, * coercing or subtly pressuring* employees crosses ethical boundaries, regardless of intent. True charity must stem from personal conviction, not obligation imposed by authority. Thus, this action is * wrong* in practice.
